checks.name: fresh_tip_per_sample_no_cross_contact
checks.detail: 48 distinct tips for 48 sample transfers; violations: []

items.evidence: Checks 48_samples_to_odd_columns, fresh_tip_per_sample_no_cross_contact (48 distinct tips) and distinct_elution_wells pass; the p1000 loop uses one tip per tube-to-well pair.
Code adds 40 uL beads, 250 uL isopropanol, then 250 uL sample with mix(5), then delay 5 min, engage, delay 4 min, remove 540 uL with the magnet on; all matching checks pass.
add_ethanol and remove_supernatant are run twice at 500 uL with the magnet engaged, then a 4 min delay and mag_mod.disengage(); two_500ul_ethanol_washes and air_dry_4min pass.

The code recovers ELUTION_VOL = 100 uL (aspirate(ELUTION_VOL...)) into the elution plate rather than about 80 uL, so it deviates from the required recovery volume even though the other timing checks pass.

The step order matches the paper (30 s soak, then the magnet, then 90 s), the reagent labels are accurate (70% ethanol), and the 4 C temperature module is set; the extra bead and elution mixing is a minor, reasonable addition.

judge.summary: The protocol passes all 16 run-log checks and correctly implements sample handling, binding, washes and drying. It fails the elution item because it recovers 100 uL instead of about 80 uL.
